feeds.title: Bereavement Single Parent Dad Blog
feeds.description: A Dad trying to cope with the loss of his Partner and becoming a single parent.

feeds.title: SingleFather.eu
feeds.description: Singlefather.eu aims to advocate for legal equality and highlight the hurdles faced by single fathers, including the often overlooked lack of financial and moral support. This blog brings you a host of articles, interviews, personal stories, and legal searches for legal support and fellow single fathers who have walked this path.

feeds.title: Tez Brooks Blog
feeds.description: A blog for single Christian fathers trying to find their way. Tez Brooks was a single father for seven years before re-marrying. As the father of four, he has a heart to see single parents succeed in the journey as they lead their children through the brokenness of divorce. His ability to relate with transparency and humor wins readers around the world.

feeds.title: KailynsDad.com
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Ben and I'm Kailyn's Dad.I'm a single father to my 9 year old Kailyn, an entrepreneur, PTO President at my daughter's school, and full time Vegas resident. For a long time I've been throwing around the idea of starting a blog about being all the above things and about life in general.

feeds.title: All Pro Dad » Single Dads
feeds.description: Single Dads: use these resources that will encourage and inspire you to be the best dad you can be. All Pro Dad is on a mission to help men love and lead their family well. Be a hero to your kids.

feeds.title: Inside Martyn's Thoughts
feeds.description: A Single Stay at Home Dad juggling his way through Co-Parenting, Home Education, Muscular Dystrophy, Mental health and cooking!

feeds.title: Single Dad Traveler
feeds.description: Single Dad Traveler is here to share my travel experience and tips for you to get some new destinations, mostly weekend brakes. I have traveled to 30 countries so I guess that everyone will find something interesting here. My original blog is in Hebrew but since I want it to be available to as many readers as possible I have decided to write also in English.

feeds.title: DaddiLife » Single Dads
feeds.description: We're one of the leading parenting websites for dads offering tips & advice on life, health and activities for modern day fathers.

feeds.title: Broke Single Dad Blog
feeds.description: A blog on thriving, when you only really planned to be one of those 3 things.

feeds.title: Diabolical Rantings of a Single Dad
feeds.description: A single dad's brutally honest thoughts on relationships, current events and other topics in and out of the news.

feeds.title: Me And Mini Mees
feeds.description: A single adopter. A story of then, now and the future.

feeds.title: Single Parenthood
feeds.description: Providing helpful resources for single parents so they can parent their kids with less stress and more love. Single Parents is an online blog written for single moms and dads around the world. The author is a Vancouver-based writer and former journalist for local newspapers.

feeds.title: INSUD Blog
feeds.description: Read by millions, Single Dad Laughing is more than a blog. It is an amazing community full of real and extraordinary people. We have a lot of fun around here.

feeds.title: The Single Dad's Guide to Life
feeds.description: Welcome to the Single Dad's Guide to Life. Sit back, relax, and laugh til it hurts. This is a place for parents tips, reviews, recipes and more.

feeds.title: Matthew Fray Blog
feeds.description: I'm a single dad documenting his journey. A guy trying to walk a higher path. And messing up. A lot.

feeds.title: GoFatherhood
feeds.description: Dave Taylor writes about his experiences as a single dad with three great kids and his occasionally tenuous grip on sanity. He's pretty sure they're related.

feeds.title: The Dating Dad
feeds.description: The romantic adventures and humiliations of a single father in the dating world. Eric Elkins blogs about being a single father and has written several books.
